# Road photo fixtures

The original images are hosted by Wikimedia Commons. These local JPEGs were resized and re-encoded for tests; the re-encoding removes embedded EXIF metadata.

| `road-02.jpg` | Tony Webster | [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) | [Asphalt Cracks (42291397720)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Asphalt_Cracks_(42291397720).jpg) |

Reference rating intervals in `manifest.json` are broad manual-review targets for regression checks, not claimed official ratings or ground-truth survey data. Fixture images include close-up and out-of-focus examples, so some expected intervals are intentionally wide.
